entities.summary: Pagano or Paganino Doria was an Italian admiral from the prominent Genoese Doria family. He was the most significant commander of the Genoese naval forces in the 1350 – 1355 War of the Straits between the Republic of Genoa and its old rival, the Republic of Venice.
